inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: An external wall of the building in the outdoor playground required maintenance. Black mold was observed on the wall around pvc pipes. The mold posed a safety hazard as it was in an area withing children s reach.     The fence in the outdoor playground was observed with three broken pickets.       Cleaning supplies were stored under a sink cabinet without a safety latch in the infant room. The cleaning supplies observed were a can of Lysol disinfectant spray, a spray bottle of clorox with water, and plastic bags. This posed a safety hazard as the cleaning supplies and plastic bags were accessible to children.      Note: This was addressed with the caregiver and the cleaning supplies and plastic bags were stored in an area out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Several bottles in the infant room were not labeled with the  infant's first name and initial of last name.  Note: This was CORRECTED at inspection as the bottles were labeled with the required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director was missing annual training for training year 4/7/2024 - 4/6/2025 on the following topics:  (1).Serving children with special care needs;        (2). Prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment;        (3). Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;        (4). Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS);         (5). Understanding early childhood brain development;      (6). Emergency preparedness:        (7). Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations;        (8). Administering medication;        (9). Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;        (10). Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and        (11). Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with 746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 of 4 childrens files reviewed did not have the child's immunization record for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director was missing current training in transportation safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: 1 of 2 transportation vehicles had an incomplete first aid kit. The first aid kit was missing a thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Three out of six staff files reviewed are missing personnel / training information. One file is missing notarized affidavit and the translation of a foreign high school diploma. A second file is missing certificates for 11 hours of annual training including the topics of SIDS/Shaken Baby/ Early Brain Development, Hazardous Materials, Food Allergies, Administering Medications, Emergency Preparedness, Communicable Diseases and Building & Physical Premises Safety. A third file is missing annual trainings on the topics of hazardous materials and building & physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Six children's records were reviewed. One file is missing health statement and a second file is missing updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of six children records reviewed is missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A 13mo child slept in a restrictive device during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Six staff training records were reviewed. One files is missing building / physical premises safety training and a second file is missing transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, operation failed to report to CCR an incident that took place at operation which required a child to receive medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant age child was not strapped while in a rocker.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the child was removed from the rocker and the blanket covering the straps was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Emergency Plan for a child diagnosed with a food allergy is missing the symptoms and steps take if the child has an allergic reaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications: Training certificates are missing trainer's qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(5))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One out of five staff files reviewed is missing 13 hours of annual training including the following topics:    -Abuse / Neglect  -Hazardous materials  -Food Allergies  -Administering Medications  -Emergency Preparedness  -Building and Physical Premises  -Communicable Diseases  -Transportation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: Four out of five staff training records reviewed include an unclear copy of the First Aid / CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: Two out of six children's files were evaluated during inspection were not reviewed by operation as indicated under probation action item #4.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Six children's files were reviewed:     #1 Missing emergency contact other than the parent  #2 Missing health statement, parent signature and statement indicating policies were received  #3 Missing statement indicating policies were received  #4 Missing signed emergency medical authorization  #5 Missing emergency contact address  #6 Missing emergency contact address
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Incident report containing accurate information has not been shared with parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Two infant-age children were obseved asleep in rockers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A group of 11 children ages 10mo-4yo were combined in the school-age room watching a movie.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A 6mo old child was asleep in a rocker and covered with a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children ages 10mo to 4yo were watching the movie Sing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the information obtained during the course the investigation; Director provided inaccurate information, did not communicate well with staff nor ensured staff followed the required steps after an incident took place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, staff failed to communicate between each other after an incident took place. This delayed a child from receiving medical attention and inaccuracy of the information provided under the incident report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, operation staff did not demonstrate good judgment when staff directed children to close a vehicle door that requires force which resulted in an injury, drove transportation van while a child was on the floor of the van and provided inaccurate statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, staff failed to provide the necessary first aid after an incident took place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, incident Report was shared with parent 22 days after the incident took place and contains inaccurate information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation children's information including emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms and parent?s names and telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers were missing from Transportation Binder taken during routes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, a child was administered a medication without parent authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: Children in the toddler room were climbing onto furniture, tables and throwing toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Staff in the infant room were not  familiar with the activities indicated under the infant lesson plan. Toddler schedule was not being followed, indicated children participate in outdoor play at 10AM and staff indicated children go out of the playground at 11AM.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last fire inspection was conducted on 11/09/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A caregiver did not sanitize the diapering surface after changing a child's diaper. Caregiver also did not wash the child's hands after the diaper change.     Note: Caregiver washed the child's hands after it brought to caregivers attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant: Play-yards in the infant room are not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(I))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: There was a bucket filled with water in the younger playground.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider dumped the water from the bucket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four staff trainings records were reviewed. One staff member is missing 11 hours of annual training including abuse/neglect training.     Transportation training for driver could not be located at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One out of four children's records reviewed is missing a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 12 childen ages 12mo-12yo were observed combined in the school-age room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: Medications were administered to three children without written parent authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 14 children ages 12mo-6yo were combined in the school-age classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children ages 12mo-6yo were watching TV in the school-age room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Napping mats are not labeled with the children's name nor number assigned.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider labeled the mats by number and generated a list with the mat assignment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two staff members were present at the operation without background check elegibility notice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Refrigerate Separate from Food: Children's medication was stored in the fridge next to food items including sauce, pudin and yogurt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Refrigerate Separate from Food (26 TAC §746.3807(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: Operation did not have individually assigned cribs / play-yards for two children under the age of 12mo.     This was corrected at inspection when provider assigned each of the children a play-yard and labeled them with their names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was caring for five children ages 3mo, 3mo, 11mo, 12mo and 12mo. Specified Age Group is 0-11mo. Classroom was over ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking Water Available and Served: No water was offered or served during PM snack. No water jugs/cups were observed in the toddler room and water fountain in school-age room is not working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking Water Available and Served (26 TAC §746.3301(f))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: Front door which is labeled as an emergency exit was locked upon arrival. All staff present at the operation were in charge of a group of children and no other staff were readily available to allow access without leaving the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A total of 13 children ages 11mo-4yo were combined in the school-age room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A caregiver was in charge of ten children, however, children were divided among two classrooms. There were four children in the school-age room ages 19mo to 4yo, one of them was in a high chair while an additional 6 children ages 18mo-4yo were napping in the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Groceries including frozen chicken patties and ground meat were left at room temperature for over two hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A group of nine children ages 11mo-6yo were watching the movie Sherk.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider turned off the TV.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: An infant-age child was alone and unsupervised in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23,  2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who  left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: An infant-age child was awake and remained in a high chair for 25 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children ages 9mo-3yo were watching coco melon during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four children's files were reviewed; one file is missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies: Operation does not have an emergency transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: Emergency Preparedness Plan was reviewed and the following items are missing:    -Procedure of how children under age 24 mo / with limited mobility will be evacuated  -How will operation continue care after an emergency evacuation/relocation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Operational Policies were reviewed and the following items are missing:    -Procedures for parental notifications  -Physical and outdoor activities policy  -Inform parents they may visit the child-care center at any time during your hours of operation without having to secure prior approval
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: First Aid kit is missing tape, scissors, tweezers and cotton balls.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Two Exits from Each Room: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation diagrams are posted in all rooms, however, diagrams signal of which way to exit the rooms but do not indicate the path that staff/children need to take to evacuate or relocate.     Diagrams are also posted at an adult's eye level that would make difficult for young children to view.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Two Exits from Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: There is not a carbon monoxide detector at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)
